text: @rongyi7/dsh-spec 是面向 DSH 的规格驱动开发技能组合，提供从模糊想法到实现验收的连续流程。它通过注册三个可由用户或模型调用的技能接入 DSH：先澄清需求并生成 requirements、design、tasks 三份规格文件，再按 tasks 顺序实现并回写进度，最后将验收标准转换为检查并形成验证报告。适合希望先明确需求、按计划推进项目并对照规格验收的开发者。运行环境要求 Node.js 22 或更高版本；README 给出了通过 DSH 插件命令安装的方式。

@rongyi7/dsh-spec offers three DSH skills: turn an idea into requirements, design, and tasks; implement tasks in order with progress tracking; then check acceptance criteria in a report. It supports a planned project workflow. Requires Node.js 22+; install with the DSH plugin command.
我只有一个模糊的项目想法，想先把需求和设计整理成可执行的规格。
让 DSH 根据现有任务规格逐项实现，并持续记录完成进度。
I want to check a finished implementation against its acceptance criteria and get a pass/fail report.
@rongyi7/dsh-spec 的功能「从想法生成规格」：通过追问澄清目标、范围和约束，并生成 requirements、design、tasks 三份项目规格文件。用户提出新项目或修改规格的需求时触发。
@rongyi7/dsh-spec 的功能「按规格实现并验收」：将 tasks 按顺序执行并回写进度，再把 Acceptance Criteria 转成检查并整理验证报告。已有项目规格、需要继续实现或核对完成情况时触发。

@rongyi7/dsh-spec README · @rongyi7/dsh-spec：Spec-Driven Development (SDD) skills for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). One bundle, three skills.

**Code is not the first step. The Spec is.**

@rongyi7/dsh-spec README · Skills：| Skill | Stage | Trigger |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `dsh-spec-new` | Idea → Spec | "帮我做一个 X" / "开个新项目" / "先写规格" / "需求变了" |
| `dsh-spec-implement` | Spec → Code | "开始实现" / "按 spec 做" / "继续实现" |
| `dsh-spec-validate` | Spec → Acceptance | "验收" / "测试一下" / "验证" |

@rongyi7/dsh-spec README · Skills：The three skills share one convention: a project keeps three reviewable files under `specs/` — `requirements.md` (WHAT, with Given/When/Then acceptance criteria), `design.md` (HOW), and `tasks.md` (ordered executable tasks). The spec stays the single source of truth; implementation progress and validation reports are written back to `specs/`.

@rongyi7/dsh-spec README · Install：From a tarball:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add ./@rongyi7-dsh-spec-0.1.0.tgz
dsh --profile <name>
```

From npm:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add @rongyi7/dsh-spec
```

From git (requires a `prepare` build script; see the DSH publish guide):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:you/dsh-spec
```

@rongyi7/dsh-spec README · Usage：Just ask naturally — the skill catalog routes the request:

1. "帮我做一个文件分享网站" → `dsh-spec-new` asks clarifying questions, writes `specs/`.
2. "开始实现" → `dsh-spec-implement` executes `tasks.md` in order, checks progress back into the spec.
3. "验收" → `dsh-spec-validate` turns each acceptance criterion into a runnable check and writes `specs/validation.md`.
